rich_description: Career Trial is a 1-to-3-month short-term job trial that lets jobseekers try out a new role before committing — and lets employers de-risk hiring someone whose resume doesn't perfectly match the job. The trialist is paid by the employer at a rate not lower than the agreed starting salary, and the trialist also receives a Retention Incentive from WSG (up to $1,500 for those under 40 and up to $2,500 for those 40+) if they convert to permanent employment after the trial. Trials cover both PMET and rank-and-file roles. This is well-suited to: someone unsure if they will enjoy a sector switch, a long-term unemployed jobseeker that employers are hesitant to hire directly, or a worker who recently completed a conversion course and wants real-world validation before signing a permanent contract. Trial openings are listed on MyCareersFuture; WSG Careers Connect coaches can shortlist relevant trials based on the jobseeker's profile.

other_criteria: Have not been employed by the trial employer in the last 6 months
Trial must be for a real job vacancy (not a project-based or short-term contract role)
Retention Incentive is paid only after the trialist converts to permanent employment for a sustained period

required_documents.name: Trial agreement
required_documents.notes: Signed by trialist, employer, and acknowledged by WSG

oth_location: WSG Careers Connect at Tampines OTH (CareersFinder counter). Coaches help write the trial pitch and broker the trial agreement with the employer.
typical_processing_time: Trial set-up: typically 2-4 weeks once a suitable opening is identified. Retention Incentive disbursed 3 months after conversion to permanent employment.
